title: X3 prompt bundle (author-metric-card)
description: The question X3 hands its author: one task per merged metric, with the merge, the statements it came from and what the SQL itself evidences, parsed. The answer is validated by x3_emit --from; this schema holds the question.

sources.description: Each statement the metric was merged from: its SQL and authored prose, what X1 proposed, and, for a BI statement, `bi_definitions` (where and how the BI tool defines the number, with the model's own metadata: context, never SQL) and `conversion_quality` (its grade and reason).

declared.description: When a source statement was compiled from a metric its BI model declares: the declaration (question_units `declared`), shown whole. The card's formula and entity are held to it; X3 adds its joins, dimensions, examples, grain and synonyms.
